card.name: Author names in citation records
card.fires_on: Author names and punctuation in reference or credit lines, such as the %A field of a citation record, 'and' between surnames, or a name after 'Design:'. It also fires on URL and file-name pieces in the same records.

modes.label: Citation author fields
modes.description: The author tag or comma in a bibliographic export record, just before or inside the author name.

modes.label: Names in credits
modes.description: First names or linking words in author or design credits and reference lists.
modes.example: P90.<< Peter>> Petocz and Eric Sowey

modes.label: URL and file pieces
modes.description: Separators or fragments inside a web address or file name in a simulation record.

card.writes: It promotes words about visuals, icons, animation and charts, so it nudges toward graphics and display terms.
card.plain: It fires on author names and web-address pieces in citation records for software and simulations.
